newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan's FIB30 stock futures hit new record high.
newsitem.headline: Milan's FIB30 stock futures hit new record high.

text.p: Italy's FIB30, the futures contract on the MIB30 index of Milan's top stocks, hit a record high in afternoon trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
The September FIB30 contract hit a new high of over 22,065 and by 1317 GMT the contract was up 1.96 percent at 22,055.
In early trading, the Sept FIB30, the MIB30 and the all-share Mibtel index all hit new records in line with the sharply firmer trend on most other European bourses.
